scope.engineRuleShape: Generic direct paragraph AX child fragmentation for inline text/link boundaries. The refinement accepts link descendants wrapped by inline emphasis elements and compacts a medial conjunction only when the saved AX tree has focusable link-containing siblings on both sides.

implementedSubGaps.name: strong-wrapped inline link boundary traversal
implementedSubGaps.reason: C.5 saved AX evidence exposes direct paragraph children split across StaticText, inline emphasis wrappers, and focusable descendant links. The previous engine required direct AX link children for multi-link paragraphs, so it skipped this reusable shape.

implementedSubGaps.name: C.5 medial conjunction no-space behavior
implementedSubGaps.reason: C.5 VoiceOver output said 'oruse our' between two inline links. The rule is restricted to direct paragraphs whose direct DOM element children are all inline emphasis wrappers, with focusable link-containing AX siblings on both sides of the conjunction StaticText.

notImplementedSubGaps.name: neighbor/card/article media tails
notImplementedSubGaps.reason: The current windows still include downstream image/group/card/article tail differences. Those are outside the C.5-supported initial-DOM inline text/link boundary contract and were intentionally not broadened into this engine rule.

notImplementedSubGaps.name: current fixture spacing conflict
notImplementedSubGaps.reason: The run fixture refinedAnnouncements still expect 'or use our' while C.5 VoiceOver evidence confirms 'oruse our'. Phase D cannot edit refinedAnnouncements, so this is queued for fixture/evidence reconciliation rather than masked in engine logic.
